note: Both sets struggle with the tabular layout, resulting in vague claims and truncated text. Set A contains several misbound circuit numbers (e.g., assigning circuit 34 to 30A and Organizer Voltage Monitoring, and grouping 29-32 for the Clothes Dryer). Set B avoids some of these misbindings but suffers from a high number of severely truncated descriptions and vague 'Main Panel' claims. Set A is marginally better due to having more complete and specific descriptions overall.
